# Plan: Verify and release Day 0

## Sources

`tests/e2e/fixtures.ts`, `tests/e2e/helpers.ts`, `playwright.config.ts`, `.github/workflows/pages.yml`, `src/render/loop.ts`. Existing docs: `docs/game-design.md`, `docs/content-authoring.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`. `AGENTS.md` is SwarmOS-generated, and this WorkUnit sets `allow_harness_changes`.

## Tests

- `tests/e2e/journey.spec.ts`: from the opening to the post-episode map, through the real UI. Runs in two configurations using `test.describe` with `test.use({ reducedMotion })`: normal and `reduce`. In reduced motion it also asserts `data-motion=off`.
- `tests/e2e/fixtures.ts`: when `SIGNAL_LOST_LIVE=1`, requests are not intercepted, so the same specs can run against the deployed site. This is how post-merge verification runs: `SIGNAL_LOST_LIVE=1 npx playwright test journey`.
- `tests/e2e/startup.spec.ts`: application startup has no failed requests and no console errors under the subpath. Asserts that no request goes outside the site's origin, which also proves the client makes no GitHub API call at runtime.
- `tests/e2e/budget.spec.ts`: performance budget. Reads `dist/` for gzipped sizes: initial entry JS at most 60 kB and the lazily loaded Three.js chunk at most 170 kB. Frame loop: counts `requestAnimationFrame` callbacks over 2 seconds on software WebGL and requires at least 10 per second. This is a lower bound on a CPU rasterizer, not a measurement on integrated graphics, and the README says so.
- `tests/unit/links.test.ts`: every relative link in the Markdown docs resolves; every artifact link is `https`.
- Save restore and content link integrity are covered by existing `progress.spec.ts`, `save.test.ts`, `content.test.ts`, and `contribution.test.ts`.

## Verified defect to fix

At 1280x720 the Rev C table's last row is clipped in the reading pane until scrolled (seen in a developer screenshot from the Episode 000 WorkUnit). Remove the blank line before the table in both manuals. A new assertion in `journey.spec.ts` checks the last mark row is within the reader's visible box after the fix.

## Documentation (only what exists)

- `README.md`: what it is, how to play (the Pages URL), no account or server, how to develop, spoiler warning for the design doc, known limitations.
- `docs/architecture.md`: modules and the engine/content boundary, as they are in `src/`.
- `docs/game-design.md`: add the service code, FORGE, and the community thread as built.
- `docs/swarmos.md`: how to claim and complete a WorkUnit here, the root-issue-and-sub-issue Epic on a personal repo (supernovae/SwarmOS#369), and why browser tests run in CI (supernovae/SwarmOS#370).
- `docs/roadmap.md`: future expansion, and first contribution missions. No promises with dates.
- `AGENTS.md`: a repository section with the module map, the sandbox lessons, and a pointer to the design doc.

## Post-merge

After merge, the coordinator runs the deployed-site verification and records the result on the parent issue. It is not a sandbox validation gate.

## Out of scope

New features. Code changes other than the defect above and the test hook.
